citations.text: The inspected entry calls 北 a *huiyi* graph resembling two people back-to-back and the original graph for 背 (“back/turn against”). It reports Shang oracle use borrowed for the north direction, citing inscriptions 合集8783 and 合集32030. The author says frequent use for north led to the later addition of 肉 in 背, leaving 北 chiefly for north. Printed page number 726 is visible in the scan; the entry is on PDF page 739. The cited inscription contexts were not independently checked here.
